description_for_model: Contract Calendar tools. Use them to list the signed-in user's contracts, show a contract's calendar, list contracts grouped by vendor (managers and HR), look up public holidays, and book or remove contract days (contractors only).

functions.name: get_my_contracts
functions.description: Lists the contracts you can see, with roles, today's date and used/remaining days. Start here to learn who you are and which contract ids to use. Closed contracts are excluded.

functions.name: list_contracts
functions.description: Lists contracts grouped by vendor (the company the contractor works through), with used and remaining days. For contract managers and HR only. Optionally filter by vendor or manager; if several managers match, returns needs_choice.

functions.name: get_calendar
functions.description: Returns the calendar entries, holidays and totals of one contract for a date range (max 366 days). Dates are yyyy-MM-dd.

functions.name: book_days
functions.description: Books calendar days for the signed-in contractor. Dates are yyyy-MM-dd. Weekends and holidays are skipped and reported. If a day falls in two overlapping contracts and contractId is missing, returns needs_choice; ask the user, never guess. Only contractors can book.

functions.name: remove_days
functions.description: Removes the signed-in contractor's booked days from one of their own active contracts. Dates are yyyy-MM-dd. Days with no entry are reported as notFound. Only contractors can remove days.

functions.name: get_holidays
functions.description: Returns public holidays for a country (2-letter code, e.g. BG) in a date range (max 366 days). Dates are yyyy-MM-dd.
